row.evidence: Microsoft's Darwinbox SSO tutorial says to work with Darwinbox support to add users, who 'must be created and activated before you use single sign-on'; the only SCIM Darwinbox documents is outbound, sending user data into Microsoft Entra ID.
row.notes: Quote-only: no pricing page (darwinbox.com/pricing 404; contact-us offers 'the right products & pricing'). Darwinbox is an HCM and acts as the HR source: Darwinbox Studio provisions workers out to Entra ID (API-driven inbound provisioning) and Okta Workflows templates create, update and deactivate Okta users from Darwinbox events (rule 3a, outbound only; recorded in fallbacks.other_sync). No public document shows SCIM into Darwinbox; the help centre and API reference are mostly login-gated, so status stays unknown rather than none. The core-hr page mentions 'SCIM/SSO connectors' without a direction. SAML SSO: Entra gallery app (SP-initiated) and Okta OIN app (SAML only). The SSO tutorial says users are added by Darwinbox support.

plans.name: Darwinbox HCM (quote)
plans.notes: No public tiers; modules (Core HR, Payroll, Talent, etc.) are quoted. SSO plan gating not stated.

limitations.text: The core-hr page mentions 'SCIM/SSO connectors' without saying which direction; the only documented SCIM flow is Darwinbox to Entra ID (outbound).

scim.notes: Only outbound SCIM is documented: Darwinbox Studio pushes workers into Microsoft Entra ID through Entra's API-driven inbound provisioning (custom urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:Darwinbox:1.0:User attributes), and Okta Workflows templates import users into Okta. No public page documents a SCIM endpoint that an IdP can call to create users in Darwinbox. The help centre (help.darwinbox.com, Fluid Topics) exposes only a few public documents; the public search returns 0 results for 'scim', 'saml', 'provisioning' and 'Entra'.

webhooks_user_events.notes: Event webhooks are marketed (c9) without a public event list.

user_api.notes: Darwinbox markets '80+ open APIs' and webhooks via Darwinbox Studio, but no public API reference was found (developer.darwinbox.com and apidocs.darwinbox.com redirect to the marketing site), so user-management endpoints are undocumented publicly.

okta.notes: OIN 'Darwinbox' (last updated Sep. 1 2023) marks SAML plus Workflows Templates and Workflows Connectors (page markup); no SCIM or provisioning into Darwinbox. The Workflows templates push users from Darwinbox into Okta.

entra.notes: Gallery SAML app (SP-initiated SSO). A separate 'Darwinbox to Microsoft Entra ID' tutorial covers outbound HR-driven provisioning into Entra.

fallbacks.other_sync: Outbound HR-driven provisioning: Darwinbox Studio to Microsoft Entra ID (API-driven inbound provisioning job) and Okta Workflows templates (create, update, deactivate Okta users from Darwinbox events).
